profile: Fluicell develops microfluidic and single-cell technology for life science research and regenerative medicine. Its products include the BioPen, Biozone 6 and Dynaflow Resolve research tools, the Biopixlar bioprinting platform and the Nexocyte tissue production platform. The company also advances tissue-based therapeutics and screening models for applications such as type 1 diabetes, cardiac toxicity and kidney disease.
